title: Greenhouse East Nash Townhome w/Tesla Wall Charger
description:
Welcome to Greenhouse East Nashville Townhome. Your whole group will enjoy staying in the centrally located, spacious, & updated home in hip East Nashville. 

3 BEDROOMS
5 Beds(1King, 4Queens)

3 FULL BATHROOMS
1 half bath, 

Washer/Dryer 

FREE 2-car garage with Gen 3 Tesla wall charger compatible with Model 3, S, X, and Y. 

This home is less than 10 minutes from the Nightlife on Broadway as well as many East Nashville restaurants & bars.

The space
We are proud to say this property is thoroughly cleaned and disinfected after each stay according to the protocols set forth by the CDC. 

This spot was both thoughtfully and functionally designed. 

✔ High-Speed Wi-Fi
✔ Air Conditioning
✔ Heating
✔ Free Parking

This is a cozy, spacious & quiet home. Tons of space - perfect for large groups or anyone traveling alone on business. Plenty of FREE parking at the house. You are close to several notable East Nashville establishments where you can find some of the best food, drinks, and coffee all within Nashville!

 The convenience factor is also a major highlight as it is a quick Uber/Lyft ride to nearly anywhere in the city! The house comes equipped with a washer/dryer, high-speed internet, and a smart TV that includes all the apps you would want. 

Vibrant East Nashville will be right at your fingertips and you're only a short Uber/Lyft ride away from anywhere in the city! There is a multitude of local favorites to explore nearby, including:

Shelby Bottoms Greenway is the perfect place to go for a walk, hang up your hammock, or enjoy a picnic with a book in the outdoors.

Guest access
You will have 100% access to this home. There is a keypad entry, so no keys to worry about and easy access into the home. Guest can also request for access to the smart garage if they would like to use the MyQ app for access.
